gbm_population_evidence.quote: History of a histologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma per 2021 WHO criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] TheraSphere GBM (other names: TheraSphere™ GBM Y-90 Glass Microspheres (TheraSphere GBM)): Single treatment of TheraSphere GBM device

The TheraSphere GBM device utilized in the FRONTIER trial is an yttrium-90 (Y-90) glass microsphere therapy for selective internal radiation therapy (endovascular radiotherapy) in recurrent GBM patients.

candidate_flag.reason: Y-90 glass microspheres are registered as a device delivering selective internal radiotherapy; coded as device/radiotherapy, but an adjudicator could treat them as a radiopharmaceutical candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have radiographic evidence of tumor progression/recurrence with measurable disease

coder_notes: Only intervention is the TheraSphere GBM Y-90 glass microsphere device (intra-arterial selective internal radiotherapy); devices and radiotherapy are not listed as agents. Four experimental groups differ only by perfused brain region, none is a control. Conditions say 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' but eligibility cites 2021 WHO criteria, so cns5.
